company.name: KR8 Digitals
company.positioning: KR8 Digitals is a creative company. We design and build websites, brands, video, AI systems and SEO optimisation for organisations that need to be found, trusted and chosen.
company.shortDescription: KR8 Digitals builds the websites, brands, films and systems that make an organisation impossible to ignore — and we build them with people we trained ourselves.
company.mission: We build work that earns its place: websites that load, brands that are remembered, films that hold attention and systems that remove the boring work. Behind every project is a company that also trains the next person who will build it.

referrals.headline: You may not have the skill. You have the people.
referrals.lede: You know a school that needs a website, a bakery that needs a brand, a founder who needs to be seen. Introduce them. When the work is paid, you are paid.

workedExample.project: A four-page website for a school

terms: Commission is credited only after KR8 confirms the client has paid in full.
A referral is tracked from the first introduction to the paid invoice, so nothing is owed on a sale that never closed.
Self-referrals and duplicate accounts are detected and voided.
Withdrawals are processed manually by bank transfer once the balance clears the minimum.
